title: John Carmack Keynote QuakeCon 2010 Part 1
summary: Audio-only recording of the first part of John Carmack's QuakeCon 2010 keynote, taken from G4TV. It covers id Software's work around that time, including Rage and platform topics such as PC, PS3 and Xbox 360, and includes his informal audience poll about paying for mobile apps.
why: Cited mainly for Carmack's offhand survey asking how many people had spent $20 on Android apps, used in debates about app store economics.
